articles.title: Crypto trading firm FalconX confidentially files with SEC for IPO, hires bankers
articles.snippet: FalconX has hired Cantor and other bankers to advise on a potential IPO and confidentially filed draft paperwork with the SEC, though the listing is not expected until later this year amid volatile market conditions.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Asia’s regulated crypto future
articles.snippet: Asia's adoption of crypto and stablecoins is driving regulated growth in payments and remittances. Learn how Singapore, Hong Kong, India, and Korea are leading the way.

articles.title: Disciplined AI agents are the disruptor needed to break the exchange churn model
articles.snippet: Programmable incentives that allow independent trading agents to earn only when portfolios rise will create a fairer market for retail customers, explains Naja.

articles.title: VanEck launches first U.S. spot BNB ETF on Nasdaq
articles.snippet: The ETF offers investors BNB exposure through traditional brokerage accounts without requiring them to directly buy or store the token.
